questions.question: What does state add beyond a single rule?
options: Knowledge of where the work is in a longer process
questions.explanation: State records the current stage of work, such as new, investigating or resolved. A local rule alone cannot do that.

questions.question: Why should an invalid state transition be rejected?
options: To make the UI more complex
To protect the workflow from an incoherent history
To force an LLM to reason harder
questions.explanation: A state machine prevents impossible sequences, such as resolving an incident that was never investigated.
